methods.historicalRateScenarios: Retains both PER_INPUT_UNIT and PER_COMPLETED_CAST hypotheses when original rate denominator is unknown; never promotes either to current Retail E or P.
methods.summarizeCasts: Zero-inclusive per-completed-cast marginal P and unconditional E; aborted requests excluded, refunds separate, co-outputs permitted, quality IDs explicit.
methods.decisionSensitivity: Given externally supplied hypothetical E intervals and time-stamped prices, bounds output value and input opportunity cost with refunds; reports only conditional decision boundary, never measured gold impact.

assumptions: Target keys are backlog identities only; this model does not independently admit recipe eligibility or ranks.
The nominal input count is required per context and is not inferred from historical TSM rows.
The observed min/max are sample extrema, not game hard bounds.
All marginal E intervals are unconditional per completed cast; never multiply by drop chance again.
Auction fee defaults to 5% only for synthetic comparison; production pricing toggles are unchanged.
Alternative incremental value is additional value beyond input opportunity cost; do not count input vendor value twice.
For linear expected gold value, correlation between simultaneous output types is not needed; it matters for risk, not the mean.
Profession skill, specialization, gear, Resourcefulness, unlock and recipe must be explicitly supplied; UNKNOWN remains explicit and blocks current-Retail raw-cohort use.
holdout: Use whole independently sourced current-Retail study families, never a source reused to infer unknown context. Require actual completed casts and zero-inclusive output vectors.
evidenceRequests: Verify source rate units for exact frozen TSM lines 1975-2009; do not modify frozen source.
Obtain current Retail 5-input recipe identity and exact output eligibility for 191469-191472 and 200061; do not assume historical mappings remain eligible.
Collect cast-by-cast zero-inclusive outputs and refunds, character skill/spec/gear, exact patch and source lineage.
Supply time-stamped AH prices and vendor alternative values only to prioritize decision-flip risk, never to assert current drop rates.
blockers: TSM mat_rate unit and original cast denominator unresolved
No independent current-Retail completed-cast cohort for these 24 keys
No verified minimum recipe-eligible baseline or source-specific profession stats
No current price snapshot to rank actual gold impact
Input 200061 mapping eligibility and batch size require independent audit
